Howon · Listen & Shadow 01

Class 1–2 Review — acting, fans, who I am, the body, the U.S. plan
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
PART 1 · ACTING AND BEING JUDGED
👤 Brian
Who gets to evaluate acting?
연기를 누가 평가하죠?
evaluate — 평가하다
💬 Howon
People in the industry and the general public don't judge by the same standard.
업계 사람들이랑 일반 대중이 같은 기준으로 보지 않아요.
the general public — 일반 대중 · standard — 기준
같은 패턴으로 — Critics and fans don't judge by the same standard. · Insiders and outsiders don't see it the same way.
💬 Howon
The experts think they can separate the good actors from the rest.
전문가들은 자기가 좋은 배우를 가려낼 수 있다고 생각해요.
separate A from B — A와 B를 가려내다
같은 패턴으로 — They think they can separate talent from luck. · She thinks she can tell the real ones from the fakes.
💬 Howon
Best actor awards are often won by popularity.
남우주연상은 인기로 받는 경우가 많아요.
won by ~ — ~로 받다
같은 패턴으로 — Elections are often won by name recognition. · That prize is usually won by the biggest studio.
💬 Howon
That's not what it determines.
그게 실력을 결정하는 게 아니에요.
determine — 결정하다, 판가름하다
같은 패턴으로 — That's not what the vote determines. · That's not what a good review determines.
💬 Howon
When I watch the same role played by other casts, I see my own choices.
그 역할을 다른 배우들이 하는 걸 보면 제 연기가 보여요.
cast — 출연진 · choices — (연기의) 선택
같은 패턴으로 — When I watch someone else play it, I see what I missed. · Seeing another cast do it shows you your own habits.
💬 Howon
That doesn't make it legit — they don't accept it as it is.
그게 정통이라고 인정받는 건 아니에요 — 그대로 받아주지 않아요.
legit — 인정받는, 진짜인 (legitimate의 줄임) · accept as it is — 있는 그대로 받아들이다
같은 패턴으로 — A big budget doesn't make it legit. · They don't accept the first cut as it is.
💬 Howon
I'm open to feedback — except the salty comments.
저는 피드백에 열려 있어요, 악플만 빼고요.
open to ~ — ~에 열려 있는 · salty — 비꼬는, 뒤끝 있는
같은 패턴으로 — I'm open to notes, except the ones about my face. · He's open to criticism, except from strangers.
PART 2 · FANS AND THE INDUSTRY
👤 Brian
Tell me about your fans.
팬들 얘기를 해볼까요.
fans — 팬
💬 Howon
My fans defended me during that time.
그때 제 팬들이 저를 지켜줬어요.
defend — 지키다, 편들다
같은 패턴으로 — My friends defended me when it got ugly. · Her fans defended her online for weeks.
💬 Howon
I'm not accepting presents anymore — I ended up using more energy.
이젠 선물을 안 받아요 — 오히려 힘이 더 들더라고요.
end up ~ing — 결국 ~하게 되다
같은 패턴으로 — I'm not doing fan meetings anymore — I ended up exhausted. · We stopped the free samples — we ended up losing money.
💬 Howon
Media play is a game the stakeholders play, not the actors.
미디어 플레이는 이해관계자들이 하는 게임이에요.
media play — 언론을 이용한 여론 조성 · stakeholder — 이해관계자
같은 패턴으로 — PR is a game the agencies play. · Casting is a game the producers play.
💬 Howon
Just because the majority likes something doesn't mean I follow it.
대중이 만든 유행이라고 다 따라가진 않아요.
the majority — 다수 · follow — 따라가다
같은 패턴으로 — Just because it's trending doesn't mean I watch it. · Just because everyone's on it doesn't mean I sign up.
💬 Howon
Some of them have already passed their peak.
어떤 사람들은 이미 전성기가 지났어요.
pass one's peak — 전성기를 지나다
같은 패턴으로 — That show passed its peak years ago. · He passed his peak in his twenties.
PART 3 · WHO I AM
👤 Brian
What kind of person are you?
본인은 어떤 사람이에요?
kind of person — 성격, 사람됨
💬 Howon
I'd rather do something different than stay in my comfort zone.
편한 자리에 머무는 것보다 다른 걸 해보는 쪽이에요.
comfort zone — 익숙하고 편한 영역
같은 패턴으로 — I'd rather fail at something new than repeat myself. · She'd rather move than stay in her comfort zone.
💬 Howon
I don't explicitly express my inner thoughts.
속마음을 대놓고 말하는 편은 아니에요.
explicitly — 대놓고, 명확히 · inner thoughts — 속마음
같은 패턴으로 — I don't explicitly say no — I just go quiet. · He never explicitly complained.
💬 Howon
I'm learning how to refuse — how to take action instead of going along.
거절하는 법을 배우는 중이에요 — 어떻게 움직여야 하는지.
refuse — 거절하다 · take action — 행동에 옮기다
같은 패턴으로 — I'm learning how to say no without explaining. · He's learning how to handle the business side.
💬 Howon
I don't look good in pictures.
사진이 잘 안 받아요.
look good in pictures — 사진이 잘 받다
같은 패턴으로 — I don't look good on camera. · She looks better in person than in pictures.
💬 Howon
That kind of thing makes me cringe.
그런 자리는 좀 오글거려요.
cringe — 오글거리다, 민망해하다
같은 패턴으로 — Watching my old work makes me cringe. · That line still makes me cringe.
PART 4 · BODY AND HEALTH
👤 Brian
How do you look after yourself?
몸은 어떻게 챙겨요?
look after — 챙기다
💬 Howon
I have a weak stomach, so I stay away from stimulating food.
위가 약해서 자극적인 음식은 피해요.
weak stomach — 약한 위 · stimulating — 자극적인
같은 패턴으로 — I have a weak back, so I stay away from heavy lifting. · He has a weak stomach — no spicy food.
💬 Howon
No matter how hungry I am, I won't eat food that isn't good.
아무리 배가 고파도 맛없는 건 안 먹어요.
no matter how ~ — 아무리 ~해도
같은 패턴으로 — No matter how tired I am, I stretch. · No matter how late it is, I wash my face.
💬 Howon
During a run, it's not stamina — it's the energy level that drops.
공연 시즌엔 체력이 아니라 에너지 레벨이 문제예요.
run — 공연 기간 · stamina — 체력, 지구력 · energy level — 에너지 수준
같은 패턴으로 — It's not the hours — it's the energy level. · It's not fitness, it's recovery.
💬 Howon
In the daytime I'm stiff, so I have to loosen up.
낮엔 몸이 뻣뻣해서 풀어줘야 해요.
stiff — 뻣뻣한 · loosen up — 풀다
같은 패턴으로 — After a flight I'm stiff for a day. · Warm up first, or you'll be stiff all show.
💬 Howon
I've got my own remedy for injuries.
부상엔 나름의 대처법이 있어요.
remedy — 대처법, 치료법
같은 패턴으로 — I've got my own remedy for jet lag. · Everyone has a remedy for a sore throat.
PART 5 · THE U.S. PLAN
👤 Brian
How's the U.S. plan going?
미국 준비는 어떻게 돼가요?
plan — 계획
💬 Howon
The O-1B visa is the one I'd need.
O-1B 비자가 저한테 맞는 거예요.
O-1B — 예술·연예 분야 특기자 비자
같은 패턴으로 — The work visa is the one I'd need. · The tourist visa isn't the one for this.
💬 Howon
I'm trying to find someone who knows an immigration lawyer.
이민 변호사 아는 사람이 있는지 찾는 중이에요.
immigration lawyer — 이민 변호사
같은 패턴으로 — I'm trying to find someone who knows a casting agent. · She's looking for someone who knows the school.
💬 Howon
I'm going to submit my scripts to a competition.
공모전에 대본을 내려고 해요.
submit — 제출하다 · competition — 공모전
같은 패턴으로 — I'm going to submit a short film to the festival. · He submitted his script last spring.
💬 Howon
What matters is how much we contributed to making the film better.
중요한 건 영화를 얼마나 더 낫게 만들었는가예요.
contribute to ~ — ~에 기여하다
같은 패턴으로 — What matters is how much we moved the needle. · What matters is what we added, not how long we stayed.
